_comment: Amazon Connect Test Desk – Simulation Test Cases for 'Sample inbound flow (first contact experience)'
_description: Each top-level entry in 'test_suites' maps to a suite. Each test_case inside it maps to one simulation scenario. The 'simulation' block is the canonical JSON that the Amazon Connect Test Designer / StartContactFlowTest API understands. The 'test_case_id' is filled once you import/create the test in the Connect console (Test Desk → Test cases) and copy the UUID back here.

test_suites.suite_name: Happy Path – New Caller (greetingPlayed not set)
test_suites.description: First-time caller scenarios. greetingPlayed attribute is absent so the full greeting plays before the DTMF menu.

test_cases.name: CVS-001 – New caller presses 1 → routed to Queue Config sub-flow
